name: West Virginia State University
tuition_note: 2026-2027 Schedule of Fees (official PDF: wvstateu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Academic-Year-2026-2027-Tuition-Fees-Schedule.pdf, linked from wvstateu.edu Cashier's Office page). Undergraduate in-state full-time tuition = $4,640/semester (12+ credit hours) = $9,280/year; this is the 'Tuition Expenses' figure, additional designated/program fees (e.g. $120 Info Literacy, $200 program fee) are billed separately and not included. Housing (room only): Dawson Hall standard double = $2,479/semester = $4,958/year; board/dining plans ($2,880/semester) listed separately and excluded. Other room options range from Sullivan double $1,750 to Keith Hall $3,881-$4,025 per semester.
